title: Audit compact controls: ARIA semantics, keyboard flows, and contrast deltas for VPAT evidence
creator: Sophia Park
description: Scope: Perform a focused accessibility audit and remediation pass for compact/ dense controls across the design system (compact buttons, pill filters, mini-table rows, small-chart legends, inline form controls). Deliverables include updated ARIA semantics guidance for these patterns, standardized focus ring behavior for compact density, contrast delta token proposals for the compact palette, and a packaged evidence bundle suitable for VPAT attachments (test scenarios, screenshots, screen reader transcripts).
acceptance_criteria: All compact control variants have documented ARIA roles and expected keyboard interactions (Tab, Shift+Tab, Arrow keys, Enter, Space)
Focus ring and focus order are consistent across tokens and density settings; visual QA baseline images added to the design repo
Contrast deltas for compact foreground/background tokens evaluated against WCAG 2.1 AA and documented with token-change mappings
Automated axe/scenario tests implemented for representative stories and added to CI smoke with pass/fail thresholds
VPAT evidence bundle assembled: scenario matrix, annotated screenshots, screen reader transcripts, and remediation notes
comments: 2026-03-05 - Kickoff: Met with Eng (Miguel Alvarez), PM (Hannah Lee), and A11y researcher (Daniel Kim). Agreed scope limited to compact density until end of cycle. Action: run automated audit and collect storybook stories.

2026-03-07 - Initial automated run: axe reports generated for 28 compact stories. Top recurring issues: missing role on pill filters, inconsistent tabindex usage for mini-table rows, insufficient contrast for disabled compact buttons in dark theme.

2026-03-09 - Design decision: standardize on 2 focus ring thickness options for compact (1px inner contrast stroke + 2px outer glow) to preserve visual density while meeting contrast. Shared prototype in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/compact-focus-prototypes

2026-03-10 - Eng feedback: runtime focus management needs clearer event expectations; engineer flagged potential conflict with existing keyboard shortcuts. Action: add explicit keydown handling tests and propose a fallback behavior policy.

2026-03-12 - Manual testing: Daniel Kim recorded screen reader flows for 6 scenarios (buttons, table rows, chart legend). Attached transcripts and notes to Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/EXAMPLE-A11Y

2026-03-13 - Draft VPAT evidence assembled. PM requested adding high-level risk/impact mapping per scenario. Added as checklist item. Opening design PR for token deltas: https://github.com/redwood-inference/design-system/pull/2891

2026-03-14 - QA: visual diff run produced 3 flaky snapshots due to subpixel offsets; will stabilize via token rounding and update snapshot thresholds. Next: engineering to implement focus ring CSS variables and add CI axe step.
notes_for_engineering: Engineers: add axe baseline to 'compact' category in CI, expose focus-ring CSS variables, and ensure tabindex is only set for interactive items. See keyboard handling doc for expected Arrow-key behavior: https://redwood-internal-docs/compact-keyboard-handling
qa_checklist: Automated axe baseline passes in CI for compact stories
Manual screen reader transcripts match provided scenarios
Visual diffs within threshold for all compact snapshots
Token migration applied and no regression in non-compact density
